title: Dummy-mode end-to-end chaos & foolproof test suite (simulate naive user exploring all features with mock files)
todo_items: Simulate a naive / chaos user exploring and stress-testing ALL studio features offline with dummy files (no real NotebookLM needed). (1) Fixtures: prepare dummy files for all 12 artifact types (PDF, MP3, Quiz JSON, Markdown guides/reports, OPML/JSON mind maps, PNG infographics, CSV tables, mock video). (2) Chaos user journeys: (a) Empty & zero states: click every button/tab/picker in overview, study studio, review, batch before adding courses, and after deleting the only course; (b) Batch operations: add empty/invalid folders, toggling artifact picks, rapid start/pause/resume/wake, delete course while busy, prompt editing with extremes; (c) Study studio: test all 4 workbench arrangements, drag reordering, unpinning all items, layout switching (stage/split/stack), turntable player with missing audio, pdf reader with missing pdf, quiz with 0 answers / all wrong / all right, flashcard rating, tutor spamming; (d) Review & Overview: clear all mistakes, Leitner box transitions, exam countdown with extreme/past dates; (e) Settings & Customization: rapid palette/font switching, extreme custom palette, dark mode toggling. (3) Deliverable: automated dummy-mode simulation test suite in tests/ (e.g. tests/test_dummy_user_simulation.py) verifying zero crashes and 100% graceful degradation.
